qwen3.8-27b.name: Qwen3.8-27B
qwen3.8-27b.about: Alibaba's 27B dense model from August 2026, and the strongest model that fits one consumer card. It thinks before it answers, calls tools reliably and reads images, which makes it the default for coding agents and long projects.
qwen3.8-27b.good_for: Coding agents, long documents, everyday assistant work

qwen3.8-flash-next.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
qwen3.8-flash-next.about: Qwen3.8's large mixture-of-experts model: far more knowledge than the 27B, with few active parameters, so it stays fast.
qwen3.8-flash-next.good_for: The most capable model a single 96 GB card runs

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.about: Qwen3.6's 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters.

qwen3.5-9b.name: Qwen3.5-9B
qwen3.5-9b.about: Alibaba's 9B model from February 2026: small enough for an 8 GB card, with a 64K–128K window. It thinks, calls tools and stays quick on modest hardware.
qwen3.5-9b.good_for: Fast answers and light agent work on 8–12 GB cards

gemma-4-12b.name: Gemma 4 12B
gemma-4-12b.about: Google's Gemma 4 12B from May 2026: a compact multimodal model with thinking, good with images and documents.

gemma-4-26b-a4b.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B
gemma-4-26b-a4b.about: Google's Gemma 4 mixture-of-experts model: 26B total, 4B active, so it runs fast while seeing images and thinking.
gemma-4-26b-a4b.good_for: Fast multimodal work on 16–24 GB cards

glm-5.3-flash.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
glm-5.3-flash.about: Z.ai's GLM-5.3-Flash, a large mixture-of-experts model for multi-GPU machines.
glm-5.3-flash.good_for: Frontier-class agent work on workstation GPUs

deepseek-v4.1-flash.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
deepseek-v4.1-flash.about: DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash, a large mixture-of-experts model.

bonsai-2-27b.name: Bonsai 2 27B
bonsai-2-27b.about: Prism ML's ternary Bonsai 2, built on Qwen3.6-27B: a 27B model packed small enough for 16 GB, with vision, tools and thinking.
bonsai-2-27b.good_for: A 27B-class model on a 16 GB workstation card
